positive_class: benchmark original unsafe label; distinct task semantics are never pooled

selective_denominators.coverage: automatic allow or block / all attempts
selective_denominators.auto_miss: unsafe automatic allows / all unsafe inputs
selective_denominators.false_block: benign automatic blocks / all benign inputs
selective_denominators.allow_risk: unsafe automatic allows / all automatic allows
selective_denominators.cascade_fnr: unsafe final allows after real verifier calls / all unsafe inputs

missing_output_policy: report native valid-only, common-support and declared fail-closed all-request results separately

cluster_units.rjudge: exact input group; source-family clustering as sensitivity analysis
cluster_units.wainject: known source family; exact-input resampling is secondary with unknown ancestry explicitly disclosed
cluster_units.agentharm: id_original shared across both labels and augmentations
cluster_units.runtime: original user task containing all attack variants and execution repeats

confidence_intervals.zero_event_warning: Bootstrap intervals do not certify rare-event risk. Do not treat augmentations or eight validation groups as independent trials.

primary_comparison_family: four typed decision models versus the task-matched selected specialist and strong LLM on FNR and FPR, reported separately by benchmark
multiple_comparisons: Holm correction within each preregistered benchmark/endpoint comparison family; secondary analyses exploratory
probabilities: native, candidate-conditional and self-reported scores remain separate; self-reported confidence excluded
insufficient_evidence: report not established; do not pool incompatible labels or count variants as independent
formal_implementation_validation: Bound to reports/formal_validation_evidence.json; measurements are executed separately

selective_curve_conventions.conventional_aurc: valid scored inputs; tied confidence groups admitted together; right-continuous step integration
selective_curve_conventions.security_curves: all original attempted inputs; failed/unsupported scores escalate; never oracle verification

paired_tests.primary_candidate: cluster-level paired sign randomization for FNR/FPR, conditional on exchangeability; exact enumeration up to 16 nonzero clusters
paired_tests.mcnemar: secondary iid-input diagnostic, not a valid independent-trial test for correlated augmentations
paired_tests.development_scope: exploratory only; no confirmatory claims from development results
